package bytesdefaults_test

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	service "example.com/bytesdefaults/gen/bytesdefaults"
	server "example.com/bytesdefaults/gen/http/bytesdefaults/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

func TestFormDefaults(t *testing.T) {
	seen := make(chan *service.CheckPayload, 1)
	endpoints := &service.Endpoints{Check: func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
		seen <- p.(*service.CheckPayload)
		return nil, loom.Fault("observed")
	}}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	hs := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer hs.Close()
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, want string
		form       url.Values
	}{
		{"absent", "hi", url.Values{"marker": {"present"}}},
		{"empty", "", url.Values{"native": {""}, "named": {""}}},
		{"nonempty", "ok", url.Values{"native": {"ok"}, "named": {"ok"}}},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			response, err := http.PostForm(hs.URL+"/defaults", tc.form)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			body, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := response.Body.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if response.StatusCode != http.StatusInternalServerError {
				t.Errorf("status=%d body=%s", response.StatusCode, body)
			}
			select {
			case got := <-seen:
				if string(got.Native) != tc.want || string(got.Named) != tc.want {
					t.Errorf("native=%q named=%q want=%q", got.Native, got.Named, tc.want)
				}
				if got.Native == nil || got.Named == nil {
					t.Errorf("default or supplied slice became nil: %+v", got)
				}
			default:
				t.Error("valid form did not invoke service")
			}
		})
	}
}
